It was desperate.|An [[Unidentified stormtrooper (hill)|Imperial stormtrooper]]|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "[[Imperial Dropship Transport/Legends|Imperial dropship]]" databank entry}}</ref>}}
A '''rebel group''' fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TFUII" /> sometime during or before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFUIIc">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the in-game databank therefore must have taken place by 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Although for a while the rebels had the upper hand in the battle, [[Imperial Dropship Transport/Legends|Imperial dropships]] soon came to assist the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]].<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rebel group was mentioned in the "Imperial dropship" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
